newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi, Hungary to sign trade and investment deal.
newsitem.headline: Saudi, Hungary to sign trade and investment deal.

text.p: Saudi Arabia and Hungary are due to sign an agreement on trade and investment early next year, Hungary's Minister of Foreign Affairs Laszlo Kovacs was quoted on Wednesday as saying.

"The three-point agreement...on trade, promotion and protection of investments and avoidance of double taxation will be signed early next year during a visit of (Saudi) Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Saud al-Faisal to (Hungary)," the Saudi daily Arab News said.

The paper said Kovacs, on an official visit to Saudi Arabia, had made the remarks in an interview with the English-language paper. It also said a Saudi trade delegation was expected in Budapest in January.
